verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly cover Suspect Commits and Ownership Rules (code owners) and Associate Commits/release tracking, which are the core repo-linking features that power stack-trace-to-commit attribution; source maps upload docs support stack frame resolution. However, there is no explicit documentation of jumping from a stack frame directly to the exact line on the default branch in the connected repo (e.g., 'Suggested Owners'/'Open in GitHub' deep-linking) or independent confirmation this works end-to-end. missing for 10: direct evidence of stack-frame-to-source-line deep linking on default branch, independent/hands-on confirmation of suspect commit accuracy.
